card.title: IPhone 8 Stuck in Searching or No Service Repair

source.title: IPhone 8 Stuck in Searching or No Service Repair

claims.statement: iPhone 8 / 8 Plus baseband faults (never repaired before): Intel models—reball BBPMU_K (PMB 6848); Qualcomm models—replace U_PMIC_E / BBPMU (PMD 9655).
After repair, update (do not restore) if still searching.

procedure: Confirm Searching without SIM, no IMEI, blank modem firmware.
Intel: reball BBPMU_K; Qualcomm: replace U_PMIC_E.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
